# Fabricator UI

> Fabricator UI is the foundation for your design system: a component registry with accessible components, extra components and its own design language. Components are copied into your project as source code with the `fabricator-ui` CLI (`npx fabricator-ui@latest add <name>`). Every component is available for Base UI, Radix UI and React Aria, in eight styles. Built with TypeScript, React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4. Built on shadcn/ui (MIT).

The full documentation is also available as a single file: [llms-full.txt](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/llms-full.txt). Every docs page is available as Markdown by appending `.md` to its URL. Component pages exist per base: `/docs/components/base/<name>` (Base UI, default), `/docs/components/radix/<name>` and `/docs/components/aria/<name>`.

## Overview

- [Introduction](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs.md): Fabricator UI is an open-source library of accessible components for React, React Native and desktop. The CLI copies their source into your project, so you own every file.
- [components.json](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components-json.md): Configuration for your project.
- [Package Imports](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/package-imports.md): Configure Fabricator UI with package.json imports.
- [Monorepo](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/monorepo.md): Using Fabricator UI components and the CLI in a monorepo.
- [Changelog](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/changelog.md): Latest updates and announcements.

## Foundations

The Fabricator design language rests on these systems, shipped in the `foundations`, `density`, `fluid-hover` and `sounds` registry items.

- [Colors](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/foundations/colors.md): Eight surface levels and six colour roles, each set by a hue and a strength, with every state AA in light and dark.
- [Motion](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/foundations/motion.md): Three spring speeds, with exits one step quicker than entrances.
- [Fluid Hover](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/foundations/fluid-hover.md): One highlight that glides to the item nearest the pointer, so a list never blinks between rows.
- [Density](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/foundations/density.md): Compact for dashboards, default for apps, spacious for websites. Set it on any container and everything inside follows.
- [Sounds](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/foundations/sounds.md): Short, quiet interface sounds synthesized in the browser, on by default.
- [Typography](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/foundations/typography.md): Inter at five sizes, with weights paired to optical size.

## Icons

Fabricator Icons is Fabricator UI's independently maintained icon catalog. UI icons have rounded Outline, Fill and Duotone drawings and web animations. Brand marks and file icons have their own sets. Packages include `@fabricator-ui/icons` for React, `@fabricator-ui/icons-react-native` for Expo and React Native, and `@fabricator-ui/icons-static` for SVGs, sprites, JSON, SVG strings and a desktop PNG exporter. Browse them at https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/icons.

- [Icons](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/icons.md): Browse Fabricator UI icons for React, React Native and standalone SVG. The gallery previews sizes up to 48 px and stroke widths from 0.5 to 3.
- [React](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/icons/react.md): Fabricator Icons for web apps and the Electron and Tauri renderers. Use `/brands` for logos, `/dynamic` for names from data, and `/catalog` for search.
- [React Native](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/icons/react-native.md): The same icons and brand marks for React Native and Expo, drawn with react-native-svg, following light and dark mode.
- [Static and desktop](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/icons/static.md): SVG files, sprites, JSON and SVG strings for any framework, and PNG tray and menu icons for Electron and Tauri.
- [Brands](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/icons/brands.md): Brand marks in one colour or their own, with their sources, licences and guidelines.
- [Animated](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/icons/animated.md): Every UI icon animates on the web in all three drawing weights through `@fabricator-ui/icons/animated`.

## App Shell

- [App Shell](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/app-shell.md): The frame an app lives in: sidebar, main column, panels that dock or float, shortcuts, and desktop window chrome.
- [App Nav](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/app-nav.md): Renders a navigation model into the Sidebar, with row actions, reordering, pinning and hiding.
- [Sidebar](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/sidebar.md): A composable, themeable and customizable sidebar component.
- [Tab Strip](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/tab-strip.md): Document tabs, as in a browser or an editor: pin, preview, reorder, close, reopen and rename.
- [Workspace Switcher](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/workspace-switcher.md): Switches the organization or workspace: a menu for a few, a searchable dialog for many.
- [User Menu](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/user-menu.md): The signed-in person's menu, as a sidebar row or an avatar.

- [AppShellBottomNavItem](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/app-shell/bottom-nav-item.md): A labelled phone navigation destination with an optional icon and selected state.
- [AppShellBottomNav](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/app-shell/bottom-nav.md): A phone-only navigation bar with slots for app destinations.
- [AppShellBreadcrumb](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/app-shell/breadcrumb.md): A responsive navigation trail that can take over the page title as the content scrolls.
- [AppShellContent](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/app-shell/content.md): The main page scroller, with optional reading widths and scroll state shared with the header.
- [AppShellHeaderActions](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/app-shell/header-actions.md): Responsive page actions, an optional primary action, and a menu for page options.
- [AppShellHeader](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/app-shell/header.md): The fixed header row of the shell's main column, with an optional sidebar toggle.
- [IconSlot](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/app-shell/icon-slot.md): A renderer for an icon passed as a component or an element in a shell configuration.
- [AppShellMain](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/app-shell/main.md): The main column of the shell and the place to arrange header, tabs, content, and bottom navigation.
- [AppShellPageTitle](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/app-shell/page-title.md): The page heading that hands its text to the header after it scrolls out of view.
- [AppShellPanelClose](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/app-shell/panel-close.md): An accessible close control for the panel that contains it.
- [AppShellPanelContent](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/app-shell/panel-content.md): The scrolling body of a shell panel with a single view.
- [AppShellPanelHeader](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/app-shell/panel-header.md): The fixed top row inside a shell panel for a title, view tabs, or controls.
- [AppShellPanelTabs](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/app-shell/panel-tabs.md): The tab list generated from a shell panel's declared views.
- [AppShellPanelTitle](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/app-shell/panel-title.md): A visible heading within a shell panel header.
- [AppShellPanelTrigger](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/app-shell/panel-trigger.md): A button that toggles a registered shell panel or selects one of its views.
- [AppShellPanelView](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/app-shell/panel-view.md): A scrolling body keyed to one of a shell panel's declared views.
- [AppShellPanel](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/app-shell/panel.md): A secondary column that docks when there is room and adapts to smaller shell widths.
- [AppShellStatusBar](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/app-shell/status-bar.md): The optional status row along the bottom edge of the shell frame.
- [AppShellTitlebar](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/app-shell/titlebar.md): A full-width top row for window chrome or a tab strip that spans the frame.

## Components

### Form & Input

- [Field](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/field.md): Combine labels, controls, and help text to compose accessible form fields and grouped inputs.
- [Button](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/button.md): Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.
- [Theme Toggle](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/theme-toggle.md): A morphing sun and moon button with eight page reveals from the pressed trigger and feathered transitions.
- [Button Group](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/button-group.md): A container that groups related buttons together with consistent styling.
- [Input](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/input.md): A text input component for forms and user data entry with built-in styling and accessibility features.
- [Input Group](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/input-group.md): Add addons, buttons, and helper content to inputs.
- [Number Field](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/number-field.md): A number input with steppers, limits, keyboard stepping and locale formatting.
- [Input OTP](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/input-otp.md): Accessible one-time password component with copy-paste functionality.
- [File Upload](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/file-upload.md): A file picker with a drop zone, checks on type, size and count, and the picked files as Attachment rows.
- [Textarea](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/textarea.md): Displays a form textarea or a component that looks like a textarea.
- [Checkbox](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/checkbox.md): A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.
- [Radio Group](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/radio-group.md): A set of checkable buttons—known as radio buttons—where no more than one of the buttons can be checked at a time.
- [Select](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/select.md): Displays a list of options for the user to pick from—triggered by a button.
- [Switch](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/switch.md): A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.
- [Slider](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/slider.md): An input where the user selects a value from within a given range.
- [Calendar](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/calendar.md): A calendar component that allows users to select a date or a range of dates.
- [Date Picker](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/date-picker.md): A field that takes a typed date or one picked from a calendar, with time and range compositions.
- [Month Input](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/month-input.md): A text field that takes a typed month or one picked from a year of months.
- [Multi Select](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/multi-select.md): Pick several options from a searchable list, shown as chips that pop in, wipe out and glide into place.
- [Time Input](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/time-input.md): A text field that takes a typed time or one picked from a list.
- [Combobox](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/combobox.md): Autocomplete input with a list of suggestions.
- [Label](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/label.md): Renders an accessible label associated with controls.

### Layout & Navigation

- [Accordion](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/accordion.md): A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.
- [Breadcrumb](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/breadcrumb.md): Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links.
- [Navigation Menu](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/navigation-menu.md): A collection of links for navigating websites.
- [Tabs](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/tabs.md): A set of layered sections of content—known as tab panels—that are displayed one at a time.
- [Separator](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/separator.md): Visually or semantically separates content.
- [Scroll Area](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/scroll-area.md): Augments native scroll functionality for custom, cross-browser styling.
- [Search](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/search.md): A search button that springs open into a search field, as one object.
- [Resizable](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/resizable.md): Accessible resizable panel groups and layouts with keyboard support.

### Overlays & Dialogs

- [Dialog](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/dialog.md): A window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window, rendering the content underneath inert.
- [Alert Dialog](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/alert-dialog.md): A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response.
- [Sheet](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/sheet.md): Extends the Dialog component to display content that complements the main content of the screen.
- [Drawer](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/drawer.md): A drawer component for React.
- [Popover](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/popover.md): Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button.
- [Tooltip](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/tooltip.md): A popup that displays information related to an element when the element receives keyboard focus or the mouse hovers over it.
- [Hover Card](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/hover-card.md): For sighted users to preview content available behind a link.
- [Context Menu](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/context-menu.md): Displays a menu of actions triggered by a right click.
- [Dropdown Menu](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/dropdown-menu.md): Displays a menu to the user — such as a set of actions or functions — triggered by a button.
- [Menubar](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/menubar.md): A visually persistent menu common in desktop applications that provides quick access to a consistent set of commands.
- [Command](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/command.md): Command menu for search and quick actions.

### Feedback & Status

- [Alert](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/alert.md): Displays a callout for user attention.
- [Toast](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/toast.md): A succinct message that is displayed temporarily.
- [Progress](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/progress.md): Displays an indicator showing the completion progress of a task, typically displayed as a progress bar.
- [Spinner](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/spinner.md): An indicator that can be used to show a loading state.
- [Skeleton](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/skeleton.md): Use to show a placeholder while content is loading.
- [Badge](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/badge.md): Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge.
- [Empty](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/empty.md): Use the Empty component to display an empty state.

### Display & Media

- [Avatar](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/avatar.md): An image element with a fallback for representing the user.
- [Card](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/card.md): Displays a card with header, content, and footer.
- [Table](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/table.md): A responsive table component.
- [Data Table](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/data-table.md): Typed columns, sorting, Notion-style filters, cells that edit in place, and ten thousand rows that load as you scroll, on TanStack Table.
- [Event Calendar](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/event-calendar.md): A scheduler with day, N-day, week, month and agenda views, drag to create, move and resize, recurring events, time zones and undo, on FullCalendar.
- [Carousel](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/carousel.md): A carousel with motion and swipe built using Embla.
- [Aspect Ratio](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/aspect-ratio.md): Displays content within a desired ratio.
- [Typography](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/typography.md): Styles for headings, paragraphs, lists, etc.
- [Item](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/item.md): A versatile component for displaying content with media, title, description, and actions.
- [Kbd](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/kbd.md): Used to display textual user input from keyboard.

### Misc

- [Collapsible](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/collapsible.md): An interactive component which expands/collapses a panel.
- [Toggle](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/toggle.md): A two-state button that can be either on or off.
- [Toggle Group](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/toggle-group.md): A set of two-state buttons that can be toggled on or off.
- [Pagination](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/pagination.md): Pagination with page navigation, next and previous links.

### Chat & AI

- [Attachment](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/attachment.md): Displays a file or image attachment with media, metadata, upload state, and actions.
- [Bubble](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/bubble.md): Displays conversational content in a message bubble. Supports variants, alignment, grouping, reactions, and collapsible content.
- [Marker](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/marker.md): Displays an inline status, system note, bordered row, or labeled separator in a conversation.
- [Message](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/message.md): Displays a message in a conversation, with optional avatar, header, footer, and alignment.
- [Message Scroller](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/message-scroller.md): A chat scroll container that anchors turns, opens saved transcripts, follows streamed responses, loads history without jumping, and jumps to any message.
- [Questionnaire](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/questionnaire.md): A multi-step questionnaire with single-choice, multiple-choice, freeform, and skippable questions.

## Blocks

Whole screens built from the components, installed as a page with its parts: `npx fabricator-ui@latest add <name>`. Browse them at https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/blocks; each has a live preview and its code at https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/blocks/<name>.

- `sign-in-01`, `sign-up-01`, `forgot-password-01`: sign in, sign up with a check-your-email screen, and a three-step password reset with a six-digit code.
- `finance-01`: a business banking dashboard: cash and runway, a balance trend, approvals, accounts, spending and transactions.
- `assistant-01`: an AI chat with past chats, streamed replies, tool calls and a model picker.
- `messenger-01`: a messaging app with conversations, a transcript with reactions and attachments, and a contact panel.
- `mail-01`: an email app with folders, labels, a searchable inbox with bulk actions, a thread view with replies and a compose form.
- `calendar-app-01`: a calendar app on Event Calendar with calendars to show or hide and event details.
- `settings-01`, `members-01`, `billing-01`: workspace settings that save as they change, a team page with roles, invitations and seats, and a plan and billing page with usage and invoices.
- `onboarding-01`: a first run of one decision per step, with a preview that changes with each answer.
- `app-shell-01` to `app-shell-05`: App Shell starters, shown on the [App Shell](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/base/app-shell.md) page: a workspace app, a workbench, a classic SaaS layout, a desktop window and a mobile-first app.

## Advanced component references

- [Audio Player controls](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/audio-player/controls.md): Configure playback, speed, artwork, and a layout that fits the recording.
- [Audio Player waveform](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/audio-player/waveform.md): Supply precomputed audio peaks and choose when the seek bar shows them.
- [DataTableColumnHeader and Filter](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/data-table/columns.md): Compose a column header or place the filter for one column in a separate panel.
- [DataTableContent](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/data-table/content.md): Render the virtualized body and handle its empty, loading, and error states.
- [useDataTable](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/data-table/controller.md): Connect stable row identities, typed columns, and a local or remote data source to every table part.
- [DataTablePagination](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/data-table/pagination.md): Offer page navigation and a page-size selector.
- [DataTableSelectionBar](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/data-table/selection.md): Add bulk actions to the rows selected by the checkbox column.
- [DataTableToolbar and Search](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/data-table/toolbar.md): Arrange search and page actions above a table.
- [EditorContent and useEditor](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/editor/content.md): Render the editable document and connect actions to its command store.
- [EditorKeyboardBar and Word Count](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/editor/feedback.md): Add editing commands above the keyboard and feedback below the document.
- [EditorBubbleMenu and Link Popover](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/editor/selection.md): Show formatting near a selection and let readers edit links.
- [EditorToolbar and Buttons](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/editor/toolbar.md): Build a toolbar from named editor commands.
- [EventCalendarContent and Agenda](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/event-calendar/content.md): Mount the grid and understand where the list and empty state fit.
- [useEventCalendar](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/event-calendar/controller.md): Share date, view, loaded ranges, and edits across a composed calendar.
- [EventCalendarEvent and Forms](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/event-calendar/events.md): Customize event chips and understand how details and editing are displayed.
- [EventCalendarHeader and Navigation](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/event-calendar/navigation.md): Arrange the title, date controls, view picker, settings, and creation button.
- [EventCalendarMiniMonth and Sources](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/event-calendar/sources.md): Add a date navigator and calendar visibility controls beside the grid.
- [FileTreeIcon](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/file-tree/icon.md): Reuse the default file and folder icon while overriding specific entries.
- [FileTreeNode](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/file-tree/nodes.md): Describe files, folders, and disabled subtrees with stable IDs.
- [File Tree selection](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/file-tree/selection.md): Control expansion and selection independently and handle open or delete actions.
- [Image Compare divider](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/image-compare/divider.md): Choose how the handle position is controlled, committed, and exposed to the keyboard.
- [Image Compare images](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/image-compare/images.md): Prepare aligned assets and label the two sides of the comparison.
- [KanbanCard](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/kanban/card.md): Customize card content, covers, and record actions.
- [KanbanBoard and Column](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/kanban/columns.md): Render columns, lanes, card lists, and per-column pagination.
- [useKanban](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/kanban/controller.md): Connect records, column grouping, and optimistic edits to one board controller.
- [KanbanSelectionBar and Notices](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/kanban/feedback.md): Place bulk actions and board feedback around the card area.
- [KanbanToolbar and Controls](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/kanban/toolbar.md): Compose search, filter, grouping, sorting, and view options.
- [SyntaxHighlightContent](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/syntax-highlight/content.md): Control line numbering, line marks, diff indicators, and wrapping.
- [SyntaxHighlightCopy and Hook](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/syntax-highlight/copy.md): Copy raw source or build a control that reads the same syntax context.
- [SyntaxHighlightHeader](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/syntax-highlight/header.md): Compose file metadata, a language label, and a copy control.
- [VideoPlayerChapter](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/video-player/chapters.md): Mark meaningful seek points and label sections of a video.
- [Video Player controls](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/video-player/controls.md): Configure the transport, seek bar, speed menu, and player variants.
- [VideoPlayerTrack](https://fabricator-ui.vercel.app/docs/advanced/video-player/tracks.md): Attach caption and subtitle tracks to a video.
